units.source_text: 名人夫妇是在一月十五日到达热海鳞屋旅馆的。

en.t: The Master and his wife arrived at the Urokoya Inn in Atami on January fifteenth.

units.source_text: 这之前，我住在聚乐旅馆。

en.t: Before that, I was staying at the Juraku Inn.

units.source_text: 十六日下午，我和妻子两人到鳞屋旅馆拜访了他们。

en.t: On the afternoon of the sixteenth, my wife and I went to the Urokoya Inn to visit them.

units.source_text: 名人马上拿出棋盘来，和我下了两盘。

en.t: The Master immediately brought out the shogi board and played two games with me.

units.source_text: 我的将棋棋艺不高，不是他的对手，提不起劲来。

en.t: I was not very good at shogi, no match for him, and I could not get excited about it.

units.source_text: 他让了两子，我还是不堪一击。

en.t: Even with a two-piece handicap from him, I was still beaten effortlessly.

units.source_text: 名人再三挽留我们“去吃晚饭，边吃边谈”，

en.t: The Master repeatedly urged us to stay, saying, “Let us go have dinner and talk while we eat,”

units.source_text: 我说：“今天太冷，就此告辞了，

en.t: I said, “It is too cold today, so we will take our leave here.

units.source_text: 下次找个暖和的日子，陪您去重箱或竹叶 [1] 吧。”

en.t: Next time, on a warmer day, we will accompany you to Jubako or Takeha [1].”
